title: Debt Servitude
summary: Debt servitude involved service connected to poverty, debt, release laws, and protection from permanent oppression among Israelites.
background: The law regulated debt-service with limits and release provisions. These commands reveal God’s concern for mercy, justice, and protection of the poor.
teachingHelp: Show the difference between regulated Israelite debt-service and modern race-based slavery. Then emphasize God’s concern for justice and redemption.
